mission.title: Signal Loss
mission.description: Make an exchange with one of the Merovingian's men.

phase.briefing: The Merovingian is willing to make an exchange with us and we need you to make the trade. Pick up the computer virus from Cassini at this address and make the switch at another. Cassini will have the rest of your instructions. Good luck, Warrior.

enter.say: ... Something strange is going on ... I'm getting some interference ... I'm losing packets left and right, it's almost like something is blocking my link. I should be able to keep your map updated. Just move forward with caution -- this doesn't feel right.

objective.text: Stop Zosma from blocking communication with your Operator

phase.briefing: This is where Fabrizio will make the trade with you. Try not to keep them waiting.

enter.say: When you find Fabrizio, they will take the virus from you and then give you the data that was agreed upon.

objective.text: Trade the virus for the data
Trade the virus for the data
Upload the data at a hardline
